Maria (CS): quick heads-up from weekly health check — ACME is projected to hit ~85% of monthly quota tomorrow morning. 7d rolling tokens +45% w/w. 95p latency up to ~320ms in eu-west, error rate ~0.8% (spike of 5xx last night). thinking we should do a proactive comm + optional short-term bump. thoughts?

Ari (CS): +1 proactive. i'd split comms into 3 touchpoints: 48h email, 24h in-app banner, CSM reachout if they cross 90%. short script + runbook would help. who owns the email?

Ben (AE): I can own the email copy + send approval chain. need finance ok for a temporary bump if they request it. can we set a hard cap for auto-bump (e.g., +20% one-time) vs sales-managed increase?

Jia (Product Ops): agree on cadence. i can draft templates. proposed auto-bump policy: if usage > 100% then auto-bump up to 25% only if billing profile is validated. otherwise we send manual uplift request.

Sam (SRE): on the infra side: we saw the eu-west p95 creep tied to a worker pod racy hotspot at ~02:10 UTC. i can schedule a capacity check and pre-warm extra workers during the expected peak window. also recommend a graceful fallback model (smaller variant) if latency breaches SLO.

Maria (CS): sounds good. Ari — can you own customer-facing timing? Ben — you'll own approvals. Sam — do the pre-warm + fallback plan. Jia — please drop templates. I'll prep a short internal notify to CSM/Support.

Ari (CS): putting proposed timeline:
- T-48h: email to account (Ben sends)
- T-24h: in-console banner (ops -> product to deploy)
- T-6h: CSM ping + check-in call window
- If usage > 100%: temporary auto-bump (<=25%) or manual sales uplift

Ben (AE): draft email below — pls review.
```
Subject: Heads-up: approaching monthly usage limit — options to avoid interruption
Hi <FirstName>,

We're seeing increased activity on your account and project "ACME-main" — you're at ~85% of your monthly tokens. To avoid any interruption, you can:
1) Request a one-time temporary bump (up to 25%) while we review usage.
2) Opt into automatic short-term burst when you exceed quota (requires billing profile verification).
3) Schedule a quick check-in with your CSM to review optimizations and cost controls.

If you'd like the temporary bump, reply here and i'll start the approval.

Thanks,
Ben (Redwood)
```

Jia (Product Ops): looks good. i also made a short banner copy: "You're nearing your monthly usage limit. Click to request a temporary bump or review usage." payload for in-app link: `/account/usage?source=banner_quota`

Sam (SRE): action items for me: pre-warm +2 workers in eu-west from 06:00-12:00 UTC tomorrow, add fallback routing to model-7b-quant if p95 > 400ms for >5m. i'll post the runbook snippet in ops channel.

Maria (CS): outreach-bot, please schedule: send email at 2025-10-30T08:00:00Z (T-48h) and post banner at 2025-10-31T08:00:00Z (T-24h).

outreach-bot: Scheduled: 2025-10-30T08:00:00Z email -> Ben (AE). Banner scheduled: 2025-10-31T08:00:00Z -> Product Ops. :white_check_mark:

Ari (CS): quick sign-off? i want to send the internal notify to Support + CSMs after we lock copy.

Ben (AE): :thumbsup: — approved from my side. finance notified for auto-bump guardrails.

Jia (Product Ops): approved. i'll put banner task in the backlog and label it P0 for tomorrow deploy window.

Sam (SRE): will post the pre-warm + fallback commands in #eng-runtime in 10m.

Maria (CS): perfect. owners: Ben (email/approval), Jia (banner/deploy), Sam (infra fallback/pre-warm), Ari (CS cadence & CSM notify). i'll follow up in the morning with the internal note. thanks team :raised_hands:

Ben (AE): one more thing — let's add a short FAQ line about cost controls and batching recommendations in the email so they can optimize before requesting a bump. i'll update and resend in 15m.

Ari (CS): sounds good. i'll draft the CSM one-pager too.
